title: Question 30
passage:
How many of my bowls are ready to pick up?
A. Two. The third one is still in the kiln. B. We close at six this evening. C. The bowls are packed in cardboard boxes.
passageZh:
我的碗有幾個可以取件了？
A. 兩個。第三個還在窯裡。
B. 我們今天傍晚六點關門。
C. 碗裝在紙箱裡。
